DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 生活環境のアンケートですね。記入する場所で迷われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the living environment survey. Are you unsure where to write something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜に帰る道が暗いことを書きたいのですが、道路の欄には選択肢しかありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜道の暗さを書く欄が選択式しかないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to write that the road home at night is dark, but the roads section only has multiple-choice answers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the section where you want to report a dark nighttime road only offers choices. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後の自由記入欄に書けます。どの辺りかもわかると内容が伝わりやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can write it in the free-response field at the end. Indicating the area would also help convey the issue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住所はわかりませんが、駅から家へ向かう途中の小さな橋の近くです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所の代わりに駅と小橋を目印として説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I don't know the address, but it is near the small bridge on the way home from the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe it using the station and small bridge as landmarks instead of an address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 地図で示せますか。詳しい場所は、余白に目印を書き添えてもよいですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you show it on a map? You can also add landmarks in the margin to give the precise location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この橋です。橋の先の曲がり角が、特に暗く感じます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図で橋の先の暗い曲がり角を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: This bridge. The corner after the bridge feels particularly dark.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the dark corner beyond the bridge on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、その目印と夜の状況を記入してください。アンケートなので、すぐ改善するという約束はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then write those landmarks and what it is like at night. This is a survey, so we cannot promise an immediate improvement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今すぐ対応を求める申し込みではなく、生活で困る点を伝えるためですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: アンケートが即時対応の申込ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: So this is to tell you about difficulties in daily life, rather than an application asking for immediate action.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the survey is not an application for immediate action. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。個別の相談も希望される場合は、その旨を別に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If you also want an individual consultation, we will hear that request separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今回はアンケートに場所と夜の暗さを書いて提出します。個別相談は必要になったらお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 場所と夜の状況をアンケートで伝え個別相談は後にすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: This time I'll write the location and how dark it is at night on the survey and submit it. I'll request an individual consultation if I need one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will report the location and nighttime conditions in the survey and leave an individual consultation for later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待合室の方ですね。受付の呼び出しについてのご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are from the waiting room, right? Is your question about the reception announcements?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さっき呼ばれた名前が聞き取れませんでした。私だったか、確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 呼ばれた名前が聞き取れず自分か確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I couldn't make out the name called just now. Could you check whether it was mine?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you could not make out the called name and want to check whether it was yours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前と、受付で受け取った番号を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me your name and the number you received at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前はグエン・ミンです。番号はこの紙の二十六番です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 氏名と受付番号二十六番の紙を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: My name is Nguyen Minh. My number is twenty-six on this slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your name and show the slip with reception number twenty-six. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二十六番ですね。受付の担当に確認しますので、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Number twenty-six. I'll check with reception, so please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: もしもう呼ばれていたら、診察の順番がなくなってしまうのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 呼出済みなら診察順がなくなるか不安を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I have already been called, will I lose my turn to see the doctor?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you would lose your place for consultation if you have already been called. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 順番については確認してからお伝えします。今の段階でなくなったとは判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will tell you about your turn after checking. Please do not assume at this stage that you have lost it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。次の呼び出しも聞き取れないときは、すぐ受付で聞いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次に聞き取れない時はすぐ受付で確認できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. If I can't make out the next announcement either, may I ask reception straight away?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can check at reception immediately if you cannot make out the next announcement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、紙を見せて確認してください。今回はまだお呼びしていないと受付から返事が来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, show your slip and check. Reception has replied that you have not been called yet this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ呼ばれていないのですね。この紙を持って、受付の声が聞こえる席で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未呼出と確認し番号紙を持って聞こえやすい席で待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: So I haven't been called yet. I'll keep this slip and wait in a seat where I can hear reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you have not been called and say you will keep your number slip and wait where it is easier to hear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待ちいただきありがとうございます。それでは、待合室へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for waiting. Please return to the waiting room.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お届け物ですね。どのような物を拾われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought something in. What did you find?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鍵を二本拾いました。持ち主が困っていると思って、こちらに持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二本の鍵を拾い持ち主のため届けたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found two keys. I thought the owner must be worried, so I brought them here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you found two keys and brought them in for the owner's sake. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。どこで、何時ごろ拾われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. Where did you find them, and at about what time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日の朝八時半ごろ、郵便局の前の歩道です。建物ではなく道路側に落ちていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 朝八時半に郵便局前の道路側の歩道で拾ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around eight thirty this morning, on the pavement in front of the post office. They were on the road side, not the building side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you found them around eight thirty on the road side of the pavement in front of the post office. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 歩道のどの辺りでしょうか。近くに目印はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Which part of the pavement? Were there any landmarks nearby?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 赤い郵便ポストの少し先です。植木の横に、鍵だけが落ちていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ポスト先の植木脇という拾得位置を補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: A little beyond the red postbox. Only the keys were lying beside the plant.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Add that you found them beside the plant beyond the postbox. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 場所はわかりました。鍵以外に、袋や名前の書かれた物はありませんでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I understand the location. Was there anything other than the keys, such as a bag or something bearing a name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋も名札もありません。二本が輪でつながっていたので、そのまま持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋や名札がなく輪でつながった状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There was no bag or name tag. The two keys were joined by a ring, so I brought them as they were.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that there was no bag or name tag and that the keys were joined by a ring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状態でお預かりします。拾った方のお名前など、届け出の説明をしますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will take them in that condition. I will explain the report, including the finder's name and other details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記入の説明をお願いします。どこまで書けばよいか、一つずつ確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 拾得届の記入範囲を欄ごとに説明してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please explain how to fill it in. I'd like to check what I need to write, one item at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the required information on the found-item report to be explained field by field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、欄ごとにご案内します。お届けいただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Of course, I'll guide you through each field. Thank you for bringing them in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒をお出しになるのですね。宛名はお間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are sending this envelope. Is the recipient's address correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今見たら、前の住所を印刷していました。まだ出さずに、書き直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宛名が以前の住所だと気づき投函せず修正したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Looking at it now, I printed the previous address. I want to rewrite it before sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Notice that the recipient's address is the old one and say you want to correct it before posting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では、いったんお手元にお戻しします。新しい住所はおわかりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then I'll give it back to you for now. Do you know the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 新しい住所は携帯の連絡にあります。ただ、郵便番号は書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新住所は携帯にあるが郵便番号が不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The new address is in a message on my phone. But the postcode is not included.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the new address is on your phone but you do not know the postcode. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 郵便番号も確認してからお出しください。ここでは住所を見て、確認するお手伝いができます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the postcode too before sending it. We can help check it here by looking at the address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この住所から番号を調べてもらえますか。丁目と番地は、この行に書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 丁目番地のある住所を提示して郵便番号の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you look up the code from this address? The district and block numbers are on this line.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the address with the district and block numbers and ask for the postcode to be checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、表示された住所を確認します。古いシールは残さず、新しい宛名だけが見えるようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, I'll check the displayed address. Let's make sure only the new recipient details are visible, with no old label left.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: シールをはがすと封筒が破れそうです。新しい封筒に入れ替えてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: シールをはがすと破れるため新封筒への入替を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The envelope may tear if I peel off the label. May I put the contents into a new envelope?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that peeling off the label could tear the envelope and ask about using a new envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それがわかりやすいですね。中身と宛名を確認してから、改めて窓口にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: That would make it clear. Please check the contents and recipient details before bringing it back to the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい封筒に入れ替えて、確認した郵便番号と住所を書いてから出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新封筒に確認済み番号と住所を書いてから出すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put the contents into a new envelope, write the checked postcode and address, then send it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will send it after writing the verified postcode and address on a new envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、ご用意できましたらお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please let us know when you are ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 記帳機から戻ってきた通帳ですね。表示には何と出ていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the passbook returned by the updating machine. What did the display say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ページがいっぱいという表示でした。今日の分が途中までしか印字されていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記帳機のページ満杯表示と途中までの印字を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It said the pages were full. Only part of today's entries has been printed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the machine's full-pages message and partially printed entries. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後のページを確認させてください。新しい通帳への繰り越しが必要か見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I check the last page? I'll see whether you need to move on to a new passbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このページです。最後の一行だけ空いていますが、もう使えないのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最終ページの空いた一行が使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This page. Only the last line is blank, but can it no longer be used?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the one blank line on the last page can be used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 余白だけでは判断できないので、口座と通帳の状態を確認します。名義のお名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot decide just from the blank space, so I'll check the account and passbook status. Please tell me the account holder's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名義はグエン・ミンです。本人確認に使える物も持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通帳名義を伝え本人確認書類もあると申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The name is Nguyen Minh. I also brought something that can be used to verify my identity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the passbook holder's name and offer your identity documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます、必要な確認をしますね。確認後に、続きの記帳と繰り越しの扱いをご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. I'll make the necessary checks. Afterward, I'll explain how the remaining entries and transfer to a new passbook will be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 繰り越す場合、今までの通帳も返してもらえますか。家計の記録として残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家計の記録用に旧通帳を返してもらえるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I need a new one, can I also have my old passbook back? I want to keep it as a record of my household finances.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the old passbook can be returned for your household records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 旧通帳の扱いも合わせて確認します。新しい通帳だけ受け取って終わりにせず、窓口でお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check how the old passbook is handled too. Please confirm at the counter rather than finishing after receiving only the new one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古い通帳を残せるかと、途中の記帳がどう続くかを聞いてから受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧通帳の返却と記帳の続き方を聞いてから受け取ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll collect the passbook after asking whether I can keep the old one and how the unfinished entries will be continued.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask about returning the old passbook and continuing the entries before collecting them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。こちらでお待ちください、ご来店ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait here. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: レシートの金額についてでしょうか。商品もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the amount on your receipt? Have you brought the item too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このパンは五十円引きのシールがあるのですが、レシートには二百円と出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 五十円引きシールのパンが二百円表示と疑問を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This bread has a fifty-yen discount sticker, but the receipt shows two hundred yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Question why bread with a fifty-yen discount sticker is listed at two hundred yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: レシート全体を拝見しますね。値引きが別の行に入っている場合もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see the whole receipt? Sometimes the discount is entered on a separate line.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらが全部です。下のマイナス五十円という行は、このパンの分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レシート全体を提示しマイナス五十円の行の対象を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the whole receipt. Is the minus-fifty-yen line below for this bread?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the entire receipt and ask which item the minus-fifty-yen line applies to. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、商品名に対応した値引きの行です。二百円から五十円を引いて計算されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, it is the discount line corresponding to that product name. The calculation subtracts fifty yen from two hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、パンは百五十円で計算されていて、二百円のまま払ったわけではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: パンが百五十円で計算されたと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the bread was calculated at one hundred fifty yen, and I didn't pay the full two hundred yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that the bread was calculated at one hundred fifty yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのとおりです。品物の行と値引きの行が分かれているので、わかりにくかったですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. The item and discount are on separate lines, which made it difficult to understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 理解できました。次に同じシールがあったら、レシートの下の行まで見ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次回はレシート下部の値引き行まで見るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand now. Next time I see the same sticker, should I also look at the lines lower down on the receipt?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether to check the discount lines lower down on the receipt next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ええ、対応する値引きがあるかご覧ください。見つからないときはレシートと商品をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, check for the corresponding discount. If you cannot find it, bring the receipt and item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次は商品代と値引きの両方を見ます。今回は合っていたので、そのまま持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品代と値引きを合わせて確認し今回は持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Next time I'll check both the item price and discount. This time it was correct, so I'll take it home as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the item price and discount together and take the item home this time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認いただきありがとうございます。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 公園の設備についてですね。どこで気になることがありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about the park facilities. Where did you notice something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 東側の水飲み場で水が出続けています。蛇口を戻しても止まりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 東側水飲み場の蛇口を戻しても水が止まらないと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Water keeps running at the drinking fountain on the east side. It didn't stop even when I turned the tap back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that water at the east-side drinking fountain will not stop even after turning the tap back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 教えてくださってありがとうございます。ほかの水飲み場ではなく、東の入口に近い所ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for letting us know. You mean the one near the east entrance, rather than another drinking fountain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、入口から入ってすぐの所です。下の地面にも水が広がっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 東入口すぐの場所と地面への水の広がりを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, just after you come through the entrance. Water is spreading over the ground below too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the location just inside the east entrance and the water spreading over the ground. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 私が見に行きます。もう一度無理に蛇口を回さず、濡れた所には近づかないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll go and look. Please do not force the tap again, and keep away from the wet area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水が広がっている道を通らずに、西の出口へ行く道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 濡れた道を避けて西出口へ行く経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Is there a route to the west exit that avoids the path where the water has spread?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a route to the west exit avoiding the wet path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 花壇の手前で左に曲がれば、乾いた通路から西の出口へ出られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Turn left before the flower bed, and you can reach the west exit along a dry path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 花壇の手前を左ですね。途中に職員の方がいたら、同じことを伝えたほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 花壇前を左と確認し他職員への重複報告が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Left before the flower bed. If I see another staff member on the way, should I tell them the same thing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the left turn before the flower bed and ask whether another report to other staff is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 私が連絡しますので、重ねて探していただかなくて大丈夫です。ご自身の移動を優先してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll contact them, so you do not need to look for anyone else to report it again. Please prioritize getting where you need to go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では職員の方にはお任せして、花壇の手前を左へ曲がって帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 設備対応は職員に任せ乾いた経路で帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll leave it to the staff and turn left before the flower bed to go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave the facility problem to staff and go home along the dry route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせいただき助かりました。どうぞ足元に気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your report was helpful. Please watch your step on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 経路の表示で、分からない所がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was there something unclear in the route display?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この案内の二行目に別の列車名があります。途中で乗り換えるという意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 経路案内の二行目の列車名から乗り換えの有無を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The second line of this guide has a different train name. Does that mean I change trains along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you need to transfer based on the train name on the route guide's second line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここに乗り換え駅が書かれています。この駅で一度降りる経路ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The transfer station is written here. This route involves getting off once at that station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じホームで待てばよいのか、移動が必要なのかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗り換え時のホーム移動が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd also like to know whether I can wait on the same platform or need to move.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you need to change platforms when transferring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この画面だけではホーム番号が分かりません。到着した駅の発車案内も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: This screen alone does not show the platform numbers. Please also check the departure information at the station when you arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乗り換え駅でホームを確認するんですね。時間が短いので、次の候補も見ておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 到着駅でホーム確認する段取りを理解し後続便も探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I check the platform at the transfer station. The time is short, so I'd like to check the next option too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Understand that you will check the platform after arriving and look for a later train too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一つ後の候補を開くと、出発時刻を比べられます。行き先が同じかも見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Open the next option to compare departure times. Check whether the destination is the same too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 後の便も同じ行き先でした。慌てて乗らず、間に合わなければその便にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 後続便の行き先を確認し乗り遅れた場合の代案に選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The later train has the same destination. I won't rush aboard; if I don't make it, I'll take that one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the later train's destination and choose it as an alternative if you miss the connection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、最初に乗る列車の行き先を、駅の掲示と照らし合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then let's compare the destination of your first train with the signs at the station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この行き先で合っています。乗り換え駅と後の便の時刻をメモしてからホームへ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 最初の列車の行き先を照合し乗り換え駅と後続時刻を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: This destination is correct. I'll note the transfer station and the later train's time before going to the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the first train's destination and record the transfer station and later departure time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できてよかったです。それでは、どうぞお気を付けていってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad we could check it. Have a safe trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内を担当しています。お持ちの封書についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'm responsible for information. Would you like to ask about the letter you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この封書の部署名が読めません。どの窓口に持っていけばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 読めない発行部署名を示し相談先の窓口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't read the department name on this letter. Which counter should I take it to?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the issuing department name you cannot read and ask which counter to consult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 差出人の欄を見せていただけますか。宛名の部分は隠していて構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me the sender field? You may keep the addressee covered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 宛名を折って、差出人だけ見せます。この二文字をどう読みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛名を隠して差出人欄を示し漢字の読み方を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll fold over the addressee and show only the sender. How do you read these two characters?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Cover the addressee, show the sender field, and ask how to read the kanji. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 部署の名前は、こちらの窓口一覧に読み方が載っています。同じ名前の行を指しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The department's pronunciation is listed in this counter directory. I'll point to the row with the same name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 読み方をメモできました。窓口で最初に何と言えば、用件が伝わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 部署名をメモして相談開始時の言い方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've noted the pronunciation. What should I say first at the counter to explain my reason for coming?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Note the department name and ask how to begin explaining your request. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 封書が届いたので内容を説明してほしい、と伝えてください。中身は担当窓口で確認してもらえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Say that a letter arrived and you would like its contents explained. The responsible counter can check what is inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 内容の説明をお願いするんですね。窓口の番号もメモに書いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 内容説明を頼む表現を確認し窓口番号の筆記を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I should ask them to explain the contents. Could you also write the counter number in my note?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the expression for requesting an explanation and ask for the counter number to be written down. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 番号をこちらに書きました。封筒と中の紙を一緒にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've written the number here. Please bring both the envelope and the papers inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号と部署名が分かりました。封筒ごと持って、担当窓口で説明を頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部署名と番号を把握し封書一式を担当窓口へ持参する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I now know the number and department name. I'll take the whole letter, including the envelope, and ask the responsible counter to explain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Understand the department and number and bring the complete letter to the responsible counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そちらの通路からお進みください。それでは失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use that passage. I'll leave you now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の薬の欄でお困りですか。看護師がお手伝いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the medication field on the medical questionnaire? A nurse will help you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯に薬の写真がありますが、先月のものです。今は飲んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯の薬写真は先月の処方で現在は服用していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a photo of the medicine on my phone, but it is from last month. I'm not taking it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the medicine photo on your phone is of last month's prescription and you are not taking it now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今飲んでいる薬と、以前飲んだ薬は分けて伝えましょう。写真の薬をやめた時期は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's distinguish medicines you take now from those you took before. Do you remember when you stopped the medicine in the photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先月の終わりです。正確な日付は覚えていないので、そのように書いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 服用終了時期を月末と説明し正確な日付不明の記入方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: At the end of last month. I don't remember the exact date, so may I write it that way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you stopped at the end of the month and ask how to record it when the exact date is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かる範囲を記入し、日付は不明と添えてください。今日飲んだ薬やサプリメントはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Write what you know and add that the date is unknown. Have you taken any medicine or supplements today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は何も飲んでいません。普段のサプリメントも、今日は使っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日の薬とサプリメントの使用がないことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't taken anything today. I haven't used my usual supplement today either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have used no medicine or supplements today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 普段使うものの名前も分かれば教えてください。写真を見ながら確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you know the names of what you usually use, please tell us those too. Can we check using a photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家にある容器の写真ならあります。薬の写真と取り違えないよう、別々に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 普段のサプリメント容器の写真を薬と区別して提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a photo of the container at home. I'll show them separately so it is not confused with the medicine photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the photo of your usual supplement container separately from the medicine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。名前と使用状況を確認して、診察する担当者に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. We will check the names and usage and tell the person conducting your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 以前の薬は先月まで、サプリメントは普段使うものとして分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 以前の薬と普段使うサプリメントを分けて伝える方針を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain separately that the previous medicine was only until last month and that the supplement is something I normally use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm your plan to distinguish the old medicine from the supplement you usually use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その区別で担当者へ引き継ぎます。それでは、いったん失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass that distinction on to the person responsible. I'll leave you for now.
